patches.name: MergenV1 Liquid Glass UI
patches.description: Brings Kyant0 Liquid Glass & Swiss-Kinetic Obsidian UI, 120Hz spring animations, radial hold menu, creator peek drawer, quick control sheet, camera-notch alerts, kinetic seekbar, and 1:1 scrubbed Danmaku comments to stock TikTok and TikTok You (Android 13+).
